title: What is Prompt caching?
description: Prompt caching is a provider-billed discount for reusing a stable prompt prefix. What it caches, what it costs, and where the breakpoints go.
lead: Prompt caching is a hosted provider reusing the attention state behind a stable prompt prefix and billing the reused input tokens at a vendor-reported discount. It saves money on repeated system prompts and tool definitions, requires an exact prefix match, and depends on breakpoint placement.
